rule.description: 不应使用 try-catch 来探测属性是否存在或进行条件分支，应通过显式参数传递和条件判断来处理。
checkpoints: 检查 try-catch 是否用于正常的控制流而非异常处理
确认是否有显式的条件判断可以替代异常探测
将可选数据通过参数传递而非运行时探测

antipattern.code:
class DSparkProposer:
    """GQA DSpark speculative decoding proposer."""

    def _get_block_size_for_group(
        self,
        gid: int,
        runner,
        kv_cache_spec,
    ) -> int:
        """Get the logical block size for a KV-cache group."""
        # 使用 try-catch 探测 runner.input_batch.block_table
        # 异常驱动的控制流：先尝试从 runner 获取，失败则回退到 kv_cache_spec
        try:
            block_size = runner.input_batch.block_table[gid]
        except (KeyError, IndexError):
            # runner 没有 block_table 或 gid 越界时回退
            block_size = kv_cache_spec.block_size
        return block_size

    def propose(self, runner, ...):
        """Run one round of DSpark proposal."""
        # ... 省略前置逻辑 ...
        for gid in range(num_kv_groups):
            block_size = self._get_block_size_for_group(gid, runner, kv_cache_spec)
            # 使用 block_size 进行后续 draft token 生成
            ...
